biomes.name: Stalker Gate
biomes.notes: Multi-branch meandering mountain and highland pass network connecting the Yuni Emirate, Stalker Range (Hub 01), Loom-Chasms, the Slabfields, and Siphon Pits around Lake Vapora.

dist.value: squared distance in map pixels to the biome's drawn polygon (pixel centres; 0 inside)
dist.note: exact up to pad_px; metres = sqrt(value) * m_per_px (core/mask KMASK.distance)

water.note: lake levels above their lowest shore cell were lowered to it

settlements.name: Bir-Sakhr Reed
settlements.notes: Floating Reed-Lake village (kits/reedlake; the owner, 2026-11-25) on the northern -1,612 m salt lake (36.8 m3/s inflow) between Sfenops and Middle Tabisti.

settlements.name: Bissa
settlements.notes: Renamed from 'Yuni North' to 'Bissa' (the owner, 2026-11-25). Locus Geomancer oil-and-coal extraction outpost (-1,887 m) on the Bruk Lona delta between Lower Verge and Locus.

settlements.name: Braita Reed
settlements.notes: Floating Reed-Lake village (kits/reedlake; the owner, 2026-11-25) on the -2,339 m lower salt lake (145.9 m3/s inflow) below Slice and Sista Riba.

settlements.name: Downback
settlements.notes: Yuni Emirate relay village on the south shore of Locus's salt lake along the Grade 1 Yuni-Locus highway (the owner, 2026-11-25).

settlements.name: Middle Tabisti
settlements.notes: Central East Abyss pure-strain Tabisti river-delta town (-1,398 m, 1.91 atm) at the mouth of the Rifar al-Rih, bridging Reed Lake and Liikofi. Added 2026-11-22 (Wave 0 hygiene, edit_521_wave0_hygiene.py; CONTINENTAL-SCOPE.md Ruling #43 & section 3.9 #3).

settlements.name: Mungo
settlements.notes: Moved 2026-11-11 (the owner) from 1321,825, which stood in the lake, to the east shore at the mouth of the Gl Shr (its record: 'Awadi n Mungo'), -1,770 m, 34 m over the lake.

settlements.name: Quintagon
settlements.notes: Uninhabited ruined arcology (2716 km, 1890 km) above Sista Riba & Verge; Yuni Emirate's primary source of salvaged scrap metal, relics & high-tech parts. From Gemini's trade model (openworld/world-pins-gemini.json, 2026-11-14).

settlements.name: Reed
settlements.notes: Moved 2026-11-11 (the owner: a larger reed village here) from 1277,676 to the shallows beside the east shore's one lake-level landing (the Rifar al-Qasr's mouth); a Tabist town stands 24 km NW.

settlements.name: Reed upriver fields (to be named)
settlements.notes: Added 2026-11-12 (the owner: more fertile ground for Reed): Reed stays on its salt lake; its fields hamlet stands 35 km up the Rifar al-Qasr (-779 m, Aw 31 C, 1,239 mm), its landing at the river's freshwater mouth by the lake.

settlements.name: Sfenops
settlements.notes: Northern independent Tabisti city. The Tabist town the owner added on 2026-11-11 (seur98e8mv, "Tabist town (to be named)", last at 1285,655) is this city (the owner, 2026-11-23: "Merge them", taking Gemini's reading in gemini/pins-and-settlement-stages-5.1): a large town of Tabisti buildings, the centre of pure-strain Tabisti culture (the abyssal people, LORE.md 6.9), on the Rifar al-Sarab above the lake's west arm. Reconcile 5.1e16.

settlements.name: Sista Riba
settlements.notes: Renamed from 'Sista Riba Village' to 'Sista Riba' (the owner, 2026-11-25). River-valley Tabisti village below Slice and Quintagon on the Braita Riba.

settlements.name: Slice
settlements.notes: Inhabited cliff arcology ruin (kits/ancients/targets/slice; the owner, 2026-11-25), sited directly downstream of Quintagon (1358,945) on r042 Braita Riba (97.4 m3/s, 348 m/2 km cliff niche).

settlements.name: Tafidda
settlements.notes: Third independent Urban Tabisti city-state (the owner, 2026-11-25), on the -1,950 m bench above the middle salt lake (-2,045 m) between Mungo and Verge where Rvr Fdd (57.3 m3/s) and Rifar al-Dhahab (24.1 m3/s) enter. Built on kits/tabisti; zero salvage, zero domestic electricity.

settlements.name: The Arcades
settlements.notes: Uninhabited cliff arcology ruin (formerly Arcoindian 3, kits/ancients/targets/arcoindian3; the owner, 2026-11-25) in the northern East Abyss wall (870 m/2 km cliff niche). Connected only by the north-south Ancient trunk toward Sfenops; no E-W highway to Trickster's House.

settlements.name: Upsprings
settlements.notes: Yuni Emirate spring village where Yuni Valley meets Stalker Range and caravans assemble and depart (the owner, 2026-11-25).

settlements.name: Verge
settlements.notes: Moved 2026-11-11 (the owner; openworld/PLAN-SETTLEMENTS.md) from 1263,946 to the foot of the Rrivar Blaca's steepest step off the scarp: a -1,685 m bench; the page's frame turns about -10 degrees so its river runs along the Rrivar Blaca, the plateau W-WNW.

smooth.note: core/world/README.md, "Smoothing": each river record keeps every drawn vertex; the page carves WSMOOTH.river through them unwarped, as the cut carved its trench

relief.note: core/world/PLAN-RELIEF.md: the cut leaves out its ledges on the absolute height (P1) and the sub-cell families the page draws (P6: gullies, aretes, crags, karst spires, humid roughness)

streams.note: core/world/PLAN-RELIEF.md P3: 44-world-streams.js says how a line is encoded; 41 decodes, curves and carves them
